recipes.title: Apple Cinnamon Upside-Down Protein Cheesecake

groups.name: Protein crust (baked on top, flipped to the bottom)

items.i: Greek yogurt or whipped cream and a drizzle of honey

steps: Cook the diced apples in butter with honey and cinnamon until soft and caramelized; cool slightly.
Heat the oven to 325°F (160°C). Blend the cream cheese, yogurt, protein powder, eggs, honey and vanilla until smooth.
Pour the filling into a lined, deep round pan and spoon the cinnamon apples over it.
Mix the flour, protein powder, sugar, cinnamon and melted butter into a crumbly dough and press it over the apples.
Bake about 60 minutes until set with a slight wobble. Cool, then chill several hours.
Invert onto a plate so the crust is on the bottom. Slice and serve with yogurt and a drizzle of honey.
recipes.notes: Estimated recipe: the creator only shares the full recipe by DM ("comment Apple"), so amounts and macros are estimates built from what the video shows. He says the whole cake has about 300 g protein.
